WITH
-- 1. Thông tin chứng khoán: lấy bản ghi mới nhất mỗi (symbol, tradingdate)
stockinfor AS
(
        SELECT symbol, symbolisin, tradingdate, stocktype, floorcode, ds_etl_pcs_tms
        FROM (
                SELECT
                        js.symbol
                        , js.symbolisin
                        , js.tradingdate
                        , js.stocktype
                        , js.floorcode
                        , js.ds_etl_pcs_tms
                        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                PARTITION BY js.symbol, js.tradingdate
                                ORDER BY js.tradingtime DESC, sequence DESC
                        ) AS rn
                FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor js
                WHERE 1=1
                        AND js.tradingdate BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
                        AND js.stocktype IN (1,2,3,4,6)
        ) t
        WHERE t.rn = 1
)
-- 2. Base HOSE: quét trade_book 1 lần, gắn stocktype/floorcode, tách sẵn giá trị mua/bán NĐTNN
, hose_tb AS
(
        SELECT
                js.stocktype
                , js.floorcode
                , tb.market_id
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.buy_acct_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Execution_Value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.sell_acct_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Execution_Value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , tb.Execution_Value AS gtri
        FROM uat_hose_stg.trade_book tb
        JOIN stockinfor js
                ON tb.symbol = js.symbol AND tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate
        WHERE tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
                AND tb.market_id IN ('STK', 'BDO')
)
-- 3. Base HNX
, hnx_tb AS
(
        SELECT
                js.stocktype
                , js.floorcode
                , tb.market_id
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.buy_account_number ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.sell_account_number,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity AS gtri
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book tb
        JOIN stockinfor js
                ON js.symbolisin = tb.issue_code
                AND to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') = js.tradingdate
        WHERE tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdatee1 AND :pdatee2
                AND tb.market_id IN ('UPX', 'STX', 'HCX')
)
-- 4. Cổ phiếu: stocktype = 2 ; HOSE market_id = 'STK' ; HNX market_id IN ('UPX','STX')
, cte_cophieu AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM (
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hose_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 2 AND market_id = 'STK'
                UNION ALL
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hnx_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 2 AND market_id IN ('UPX', 'STX')
        ) x
)
-- 5. Trái phiếu DN niêm yết: stocktype = 1 ; HOSE market_id = 'BDO' ; HNX market_id = 'HCX'
, cte_tpdn_niemyet AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM (
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hose_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 1 AND market_id = 'BDO'
                UNION ALL
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hnx_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 1 AND market_id = 'HCX'
        ) x
)
-- 6. CCQ: stocktype IN (3,6)
--    (chưa có rule market_id nên giữ như câu lệnh gốc: HOSE = 'STK', HNX = 'UPX'/'STX')
, cte_ccq AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM (
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hose_tb
                WHERE stocktype IN (3,6) 
                UNION ALL
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hnx_tb
                WHERE stocktype IN (3,6) 
        ) x
)
-- 7. CW: stocktype = 4 AND floorcode = 10 (HOSE, market_id = 'STK')
, cte_cw AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM hose_tb
        WHERE stocktype = 4 AND floorcode = 10 AND market_id = 'STK'
)
-- 8. TP DN riêng lẻ: báo cáo HNX09
, cte_tpdn_riengle AS
(
        SELECT
                SUM(CASE WHEN fr.row_path = 'GIÁ TRỊ GIAO DỊCH NHÀ ĐẦU TƯ NƯỚC NGOÀI - GIÁ TRỊ MUA' THEN fr.field_value END) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua
                , SUM(CASE WHEN fr.row_path = 'GIÁ TRỊ GIAO DỊCH NHÀ ĐẦU TƯ NƯỚC NGOÀI - GIÁ TRỊ BÁN' THEN fr.field_value END) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban
                , SUM(CASE WHEN fr.row_path = 'GIÁ TRỊ GIAO DỊCH' THEN fr.field_value END) AS tong_gtri
        FROM uat_iss_ods.flat_report fr
        WHERE fr.report_code = 'HNX09'
                AND fr.submit_status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'LATE_SUBMITTED')
                and fr.date_type ='DAILY'
                 AND fr.origin_date_value BETWEEN :pdateeee1 AND :pdateeee2
)
-- 9. TP chính phủ: Outright + Repo + Repo2
, tpcp_raw AS
(
        SELECT
                CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(a.buying_account_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN a.trading_value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(a.selling_account_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN a.trading_value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , a.trading_value AS gtri
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.OUTRIGHT_ORDER_BOOK a
        WHERE a.trading_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
                CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.buying_account_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.selling_account_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , r.first_settlement_value
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.REPO_ORDER_BOOK r
        WHERE r.trading_date  BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
                CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.buying_account_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.selling_account_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , r.first_settlement_value
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.REPO2_ORDER_BOOK r
        WHERE r.trading_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
)
, cte_tpcp AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM tpcp_raw
)
, cte_all AS
(
        SELECT 'CP' AS loai_ck, gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban, gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM cte_cophieu
                UNION ALL
        SELECT 'CCQ', gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban, gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM cte_ccq
                UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Chứng quyền', gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban, gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM cte_cw
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'TPCP', SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_ban), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban) as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM cte_tpcp
                UNION ALL
        SELECT 'TPDN RL', SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_ban), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban) as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM cte_tpdn_riengle
                UNION ALL
        SELECT 'TPDN NY', SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_ban), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban) as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM cte_tpdn_niemyet
)
select SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua),SUM(gtri_ndtnn_ban), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban) as gtri_mua_ban_rong  from cte_all;

WITH
-- 1. Thông tin chứng khoán: lấy bản ghi mới nhất mỗi (symbol, tradingdate)
stockinfor AS
(
        SELECT symbol, symbolisin, tradingdate, stocktype, floorcode, ds_etl_pcs_tms
        FROM (
                SELECT
                        js.symbol
                        , js.symbolisin
                        , js.tradingdate
                        , js.stocktype
                        , js.floorcode
                        , js.ds_etl_pcs_tms
                        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                PARTITION BY js.tradingdate, js.sequence
                                ORDER BY js.tradingtime DESC, sequence DESC
                        ) AS rn
                FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor js
                WHERE 1=1
                        AND js.tradingdate BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
                        AND js.stocktype = 2
        ) t
        WHERE t.rn = 1
)
-- 2. Base HOSE: quét trade_book 1 lần, gắn stocktype/floor_code, tách sẵn giá trị mua/bán NĐTNN
, hose_tb AS
(
        SELECT
                js.stocktype
                , js.floorcode
                , tb.market_id
                , tb.trade_date 
                , tb.symbol
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.buy_acct_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Execution_Value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.sell_acct_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Execution_Value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , tb.Execution_Value AS gtri
        FROM uat_hose_stg.trade_book tb
        JOIN stockinfor js
                ON tb.symbol = js.symbol AND tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate
        WHERE tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
                AND tb.market_id IN ('STK', 'BDO')
)
-- 3. Base HNX
, hnx_tb AS
(
        SELECT
                js.stocktype
                , js.floorcode
                , tb.market_id
                , tb.trade_date 
                , js.symbol
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.buy_account_number ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.sell_account_number,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity AS gtri
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book tb
        JOIN stockinfor js
                ON js.symbolisin = tb.issue_code
                AND to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') = js.tradingdate
        WHERE tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdatee1 AND :pdatee2
                AND tb.market_id IN ('UPX', 'STX', 'HCX')
)
-- 4. Cổ phiếu: stocktype = 2 ; HOSE market_id = 'STK' ; HNX market_id IN ('UPX','STX')
, cte_cophieu AS
(
        SELECT ma_ck, SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM (
                SELECT symbol ma_ck, gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hose_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 2 AND market_id = 'STK'
                UNION ALL
                SELECT symbol ma_ck, gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hnx_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 2 AND market_id IN ('UPX', 'STX')
        ) x group by ma_ck
)
SELECT
        ma_ck
        , SUM(NVL(gtri_ndtnn_mua,0))+SUM(NVL(gtri_ndtnn_ban,0)) ty_trong
FROM cte_cophieu
order by ty_trong
limit 5;

WITH base_cell AS (

    FROM uat_fims_ods.fir_value

      AND is_static_copy = 0

),
base_rows AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        report_log_id,
        section_id,
        row_path,
        row_order,
        entity_code
    FROM base_cell
),
c_loai_hinh AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order, COALESCE(value_raw, value_raw) AS loai_hinh_to_chuc
    FROM base_cell WHERE column_path = 'Loại hình đối với tổ chức'
),
c_gtri_danh_muc AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order, 
           COALESCE(value_raw, CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(value_raw, ""^'"", """") AS DOUBLE)) AS tong_gtri_danh_muc
    FROM base_cell WHERE column_path = 'Giá trị dòng vốn vào trong kỳ báo cáo (+/-) (đơn vị USD)'
),
pvt_data AS (
    SELECT
        b.row_path,
        b.row_order,
        b.entity_code,
        c_loai_hinh.loai_hinh_to_chuc,
        c_gtri_danh_muc.tong_gtri_danh_muc
    FROM base_rows b
    LEFT JOIN c_loai_hinh     ON b.report_log_id = c_loai_hinh.report_log_id     AND b.section_id = c_loai_hinh.section_id     AND b.row_order = c_loai_hinh.row_order
    LEFT JOIN c_gtri_danh_muc ON b.report_log_id = c_gtri_danh_muc.report_log_id AND b.section_id = c_gtri_danh_muc.section_id AND b.row_order = c_gtri_danh_muc.row_order
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(loai_hinh_to_chuc, 'Cá nhân / Chưa xác định') AS loai_hinh_to_chuc,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN row_path = 'B-Cá nhân' THEN tong_gtri_danh_muc END), 4) AS tong_gtri_danh_muc_ca_nhan,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE
        WHEN row_path = 'A-Tổ chức' 
             AND (loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Công ty%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Ngân hàng%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Tổ chức%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Không phải quỹ%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Các loại khác%') 
        THEN tong_gtri_danh_muc
    END), 4) AS dong_von_rong_tochuc_khac_quy,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE
        WHEN row_path = 'A-Tổ chức' 
             AND loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Quỹ%' 
             AND loai_hinh_to_chuc NOT LIKE '%Không phải quỹ%' 
        THEN tong_gtri_danh_muc
    END), 4) AS dong_von_rong_quy
FROM pvt_data
WHERE tong_gtri_danh_muc IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(loai_hinh_to_chuc, 'Cá nhân / Chưa xác định');

column19:
WITH
stockinfor AS 
(
        SELECT
                symbol
                , symbolisin 
                , tradingdate 
                , stocktype 
                , ds_etl_pcs_tms 
        FROM (
                SELECT
                        js.symbol
                        , js.symbolisin 
                        , js.tradingdate 
                        , js.stocktype 
                        , js.ds_etl_pcs_tms
                        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                PARTITION BY js.symbol, js.tradingdate 
                                ORDER BY js.tradingtime DESC, sequence DESC
                        ) AS rn
                FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor js 
                WHERE 1=1
                        AND js.tradingdate BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2 AND js.stocktype IN (1, 2, 3, 6)
        ) t
        WHERE t.rn = 1
),
raw_trades AS (
    SELECT 
        to_date(trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')                        AS trade_date,
        execution_value                          AS execution_value,
        CASE WHEN buy_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN execution_value ELSE 0.0 END   AS gtri_ndtnn_mua,
        CASE WHEN sell_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN execution_value ELSE 0.0 END   AS gtri_ndtnn_ban
    FROM uat_hose_stg.trade_book tb
    join stockinfor js on tb.symbol = js.symbol and tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate 
    WHERE         tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
    and ds_snpst_dt = to_date('20260907','yyyyMMdd')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        to_date(trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd')                          AS trade_date,
        trade_price * trade_quantity             AS execution_value,
        CASE WHEN buy_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN trade_price * trade_quantity ELSE 0.0 END AS gtri_ndtnn_mua,
        CASE WHEN sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN trade_price * trade_quantity ELSE 0.0 END AS gtri_ndtnn_ban
    FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book tb
    join stockinfor js on js.symbolisin = tb.issue_code and to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') = js.tradingdate 
    WHERE         tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdatee1 AND :pdatee2
    and ds_snpst_dt = to_date('20260907','yyyyMMdd')
),
base_trades AS (
    SELECT 
        t.trade_date,
        t.execution_value,
        t.gtri_ndtnn_mua,
        t.gtri_ndtnn_ban
    FROM raw_trades t
),
daily_summary AS (
    SELECT 
            trade_date,
        sum(gtri_ndtnn_mua)  AS gtri_mua_ngay,
        sum(gtri_ndtnn_ban)  AS gtri_ban_ngay
    FROM base_trades
    group by trade_date
)
SELECT 
    trade_date  AS ngay_gd,
    gtri_mua_ngay - gtri_ban_ngay as mua_ban_rong
FROM daily_summary;

WITH ranked_day AS (
    -- Bước 1: bản ghi cuối cùng (indexTime lớn nhất) của mỗi ngày giao dịch
    SELECT
        m.tradingdate,
        m.marketId,
        m.marketCode,
        m.marketIndex,
        m.indexTime,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.marketId, m.marketCode, m.tradingdate
            ORDER BY m.indexTime DESC
        ) AS rn_day
    FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_marketinfor m
    WHERE 1=1
        AND m.tradingdate BETWEEN :tu_ngay AND :den_ngay   -- 'yyyyMMdd'
        AND m.marketId   = '10'
        AND m.marketCode = 'HOSE'
),
last_of_day AS (
    SELECT tradingdate, marketId, marketCode, marketIndex, indexTime
    FROM ranked_day
    WHERE rn_day = 1
),
ranked_month AS (
    -- Bước 2: trong mỗi tháng, xếp hạng ngày giao dịch giảm dần
    SELECT
        d.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.marketId, d.marketCode, SUBSTR(d.tradingdate, 1, 6)
            ORDER BY d.tradingdate DESC
        ) AS rn_month
    FROM last_of_day d
)
SELECT
    tradingdate,
    marketId,
    marketCode,
    marketIndex,
    indexTime
FROM ranked_month
WHERE rn_month = 1
ORDER BY tradingdate, marketId, marketCode;

c_gtri_danh_muc AS (

           TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell
    WHERE sheet_name = 'II'
      AND column_path in (
     		'Cổ phiếu/Chứng chỉ quỹ > Cổ phiếu công ty đại chúng đăng ký giao dịch (upcom) > Giá trị'

			,'Trái phiếu > Thời gian còn lại tới khi đáo hạn > Trung hạn > Từ 12 tháng đến 24 tháng > Giá trị'
			,'Cổ phiếu/Chứng chỉ quỹ > Giá trị vốn góp mua cổ phần, quỹ thành viên và chứng khoán khác > Giá trị'

			,'Tiền và các khoản tương đương tiền (chứng chỉ tiền gửi...) > Giá trị'
     	)
),
inv AS (
    SELECT
        SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(TransactionCode)), -6) AS ma_gd_key,
        Name,
        ObjectType,
        InvestorTypeId
    FROM uat_fims_stg.investor
    WHERE TRIM(TransactionCode) <> '' 
      AND Deleted = 0
),
quy AS (
    SELECT
        'Quỹ' as nhom_loai_hinh,
        sum(g.tong_gtri) as tong_gtri
    FROM base_rows b
    LEFT JOIN c_ma_gd m
           ON b.report_log_id = m.report_log_id

    JOIN inv

    LEFT JOIN uat_fims_stg.investortype it

    WHERE inv.ObjectType = 2 and it.Name LIKE '%Quỹ%' or it.Name like '%Fund%*'

),

			,'Tín phiếu > Giá trị'

from tong_hop;

    FROM base_cell WHERE sheet_name = 'II' and column_path = 'Tín phiếu > Giá trị'

    	'Tín phiếu' as loai_hinh,

    FROM base_cell WHERE report_code = '59WJB' and sheet_name = 'III' and column_path = 'A. Tín phiếu' and column_path = 'Số dư cuối kỳ > Giá trị'
),
c_trai_phieu AS (
    SELECT 
        'Trái phiếu' as loai_hinh,
    	SUM(TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell 
    WHERE column_path IN (
        'Trái phiếu > Thời gian còn lại tới khi đáo hạn > Ngắn hạn > Dưới 12 tháng > Giá trị',
        'Trái phiếu > Thời gian còn lại tới khi đáo hạn > Trung hạn > Từ 12 tháng đến 24 tháng > Giá trị',
        'Trái phiếu > Thời gian còn lại tới khi đáo hạn > Dài hạn > Trên 24 tháng > Giá trị'
    )
    union all 
    SELECT 
    	'Trái phiếu' as loai_hinh,
    	SUM(TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell WHERE report_code = '59WJB' and sheet_name = 'III' and column_path in 
    (
    	'B. Trái phiếu > B1.Trái phiếu có thời gian tới khi đáo hạn còn lại dưới 12 tháng'
		,'B. Trái phiếu > B3. Trái phiếu có thời gian tới khi đáo hạn còn lại trên 24 tháng đến 60 tháng'
		,'B. Trái phiếu > B2. Trái phiếu có thời gian tới khi đáo hạn còn lại từ 12 tháng đến 24 tháng'
		,'B. Trái phiếu > B4. Trái phiếu có thời gian đáo hạn trên 60 tháng'
    )

    	SUM(TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell WHERE sheet_name = 'II' and column_path = 'Cổ phiếu/Chứng chỉ quỹ > Cổ phiếu niêm yết, chứng chỉ quỹ niêm yết > Giá trị'
    union all 
    SELECT 
    	'CP/CCQ' as loai_hinh,
    	SUM(TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell WHERE report_code = '59WJB' and sheet_name = 'III' and row_path = 'C. Cổ phiếu niêm yết, chứng chỉ quỹ niêm yết' and column_path = 'Số dư cuối kỳ > Giá trị'
),
c_upcom AS (
    SELECT 'Upcom' AS loai_hinh,
    	SUM(TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell WHERE report_code = '59WJB' and sheet_name = 'II' and column_path = 'Cổ phiếu/Chứng chỉ quỹ > Cổ phiếu công ty đại chúng đăng ký giao dịch (upcom) > Giá trị'
    union all 
    SELECT 
    	'Upcom' as loai_hinh,
    	SUM(TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell WHERE sheet_name = 'III' and row_path = 'D. Cổ phiếu công ty đại chúng đăng ký giao dịch (upcom)' and column_path = 'Số dư cuối kỳ > Giá trị'
),
c_gtri_von_gop AS (
    SELECT 'Giá trị vốn góp' AS loai_hinh,
    	SUM(TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell WHERE  sheet_name = 'II' and column_path = 'Cổ phiếu/Chứng chỉ quỹ > Giá trị vốn góp mua cổ phần, quỹ thành viên và chứng khoán khác > Giá trị'
    union all 
    SELECT 
    	'Giá trị vốn góp' as loai_hinh,
    	SUM(TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell WHERE report_code = '59WJB' and sheet_name = 'III' and row_path = 'Đ. Giá trị vốn góp mua cổ phần, đơn vị quỹ thành viên' and column_path = 'Số dư cuối kỳ > Giá trị'
),
c_tien AS (
    SELECT 'Tiền và các khoản tương đương tiền' AS loai_hinh,
    	SUM(TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell WHERE sheet_name = 'II' and column_path = 'Tiền và các khoản tương đương tiền (chứng chỉ tiền gửi...) > Giá trị'
    union all 
    SELECT 
    	'Tiền và các khoản tương đương tiền' as loai_hinh,
    	SUM(TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell WHERE report_code = '59WJB' and sheet_name = 'III' and row_path in 
    (
    	'G. Tiền và các khoản tương đương tiền (Chứng chỉ tiền gửi và các công cụ thị trường tiền tệ ..) > 2. Chứng chỉ tiền gửi và công cụ thị trường tiền tệ...'
		,'G. Tiền và các khoản tương đương tiền (Chứng chỉ tiền gửi và các công cụ thị trường tiền tệ ..) > 1. Tiền'
    )
    and column_path = 'Số dư cuối kỳ > Giá trị'
),
c_gtri_danh_muc AS (
    SELECT 'Tổng' AS loai_hinh,
    	SUM(TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS tong_gtri
    FROM base_cell WHERE column_path = 'Tổng giá trị danh mục > Giá trị'
),
pvt_data AS (
	select 
		sum(case when loai_hinh = 'Tín phiếu' then tong_gtri end) as tin_phieu,
		sum(case when loai_hinh = 'Trái phiếu' then tong_gtri end) as trai_phieu,
		sum(case when loai_hinh = 'CP/CCQ' then tong_gtri end) as CP_CCQ,
		sum(case when loai_hinh = 'Upcom' then tong_gtri end) as upcom,
		sum(case when loai_hinh = 'Giá trị vốn góp' then tong_gtri end) as gtri_von_gop,
		sum(case when loai_hinh = 'Tiền và các khoản tương đương tiền' then tong_gtri end) as tien,
		sum(case when loai_hinh = 'Tín phiếu' then tong_gtri end) + sum(case when loai_hinh = 'Trái phiếu' then tong_gtri end)
		+ sum(case when loai_hinh = 'CP/CCQ' then tong_gtri end) + sum(case when loai_hinh = 'Upcom' then tong_gtri end) 
		+ sum(case when loai_hinh = 'Upcom' then tong_gtri end) + sum(case when loai_hinh = 'Giá trị vốn góp' then tong_gtri end)
		+ sum(case when loai_hinh = 'Tiền và các khoản tương đương tiền' then tong_gtri end) as tong_tai_san
	from (
    select loai_hinh, sum(tong_gtri) as tong_gtri from c_tin_phieu group by loai_hinh
    union all 
     select loai_hinh, sum(tong_gtri) as tong_gtri from c_trai_phieu group by loai_hinh
    union all 
     select loai_hinh, sum(tong_gtri) as tong_gtri from c_CCQ group by loai_hinh
    union all 
     select loai_hinh, sum(tong_gtri) as tong_gtri from c_upcom group by loai_hinh
    union all 
     select loai_hinh, sum(tong_gtri) as tong_gtri from c_gtri_von_gop group by loai_hinh
    union all 
    select loai_hinh, sum(tong_gtri) as tong_gtri from c_tien group by loai_hinh
    )
)
select 
	tin_phieu*100/tong_tai_san as tin_phieu,
	trai_phieu*100/tong_tai_san as trai_phieu,
	CP_CCQ*100/tong_tai_san as CP_CCQ,
	upcom*100/tong_tai_san as upcom,
	gtri_von_gop*100/tong_tai_san as gtri_von_gop,
	tien*100/tong_tai_san as tien
from pvt_data;

WITH
-- 1. Xác định ngày giao dịch thực tế cuối cùng trong tháng dựa trên tham số truyền vào
max_trading_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(tradingdate) AS last_trading_date
    FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor
    WHERE TRUNC(tradingdate, 'MM') = TRUNC(:pdateee, 'MM')
      AND stocktype = 2
),
-- 2. Thông tin chứng khoán: lấy bản ghi mới nhất của ngày cuối tháng đó
stockinfor AS (
    SELECT symbol, symbolisin, tradingdate, closeprice, floorcode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            js.symbol,
            js.symbolisin,
            js.tradingdate,
            js.closeprice,
            js.floorcode,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY js.symbol, js.tradingdate
                ORDER BY js.tradingtime DESC, js.sequence DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor js
        JOIN max_trading_date mtd 
          ON js.tradingdate = mtd.last_trading_date
        WHERE js.stocktype = 2
    ) t
    WHERE t.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    NVL(c.industry_name, 'Chưa phân ngành') AS nganh,
    SUM(fii.current_shares_foreign_hold * js.closeprice) AS room
FROM uat_vsdc_stg.foreign_investor_info_test fii
JOIN max_trading_date mtd 
  ON fii.ds_snpst_dt = mtd.last_trading_date
JOIN stockinfor js 
  ON fii.ticker_symbol = js.symbol
LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp 
  ON fii.ticker_symbol = cp.equity_ticker 
 AND cp.delete_flg = 0
LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.categories c 
  ON cp.category_l1_id = c.id
GROUP BY NVL(c.industry_name, 'Chưa phân ngành')
ORDER BY room DESC;

WITH base_cell AS (
    SELECT
        report_log_id,
        section_id,
        row_order,
        column_path,
        sheet_name,
        value_raw
    FROM uat_fims_ods.fir_value
    WHERE report_code IN ('59WJB', 'BZ5X4')
                AND        sheet_name = 'II'
      AND is_mirror = 0
      AND is_section_echo = 0
      AND is_band_overflow = 0
      AND is_static_copy = 0
      AND is_template_marker = 0
      AND is_total_row = 0            
      AND ngay_nop = :ngaynop
),
base_rows AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT report_log_id, section_id, row_order
    FROM base_cell
),
c_ma_gd AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order,
           SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(value_raw)),-6) AS ma_so_gd
    FROM base_cell
    WHERE column_path = 'Mã số giao dịch chứng khoán'   -- cần xác nhận đúng column_path
),
c_ten_kh AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order,
           UPPER(TRIM(value_raw)) AS ten_kh
    FROM base_cell
    WHERE  column_path = 'Tên khách hàng'   
),
c_gtri_danh_muc AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order,
           TRY_CAST(value_raw AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS tong_gtri_danh_muc
    FROM base_cell
    WHERE  column_path = 'Tổng giá trị danh mục > Giá trị'
),
pvt_dt as 
(
        SELECT 
                m.ma_so_gd,
                c.ten_kh,
                g.tong_gtri_danh_muc
        FROM base_rows b
        LEFT JOIN c_ten_kh c
           ON b.report_log_id = c.report_log_id
          AND b.section_id    = c.section_id
          AND b.row_order     = c.row_order
    LEFT JOIN c_gtri_danh_muc g
           ON b.report_log_id = g.report_log_id
          AND b.section_id    = g.section_id
          AND b.row_order     = g.row_order
    LEFT JOIN c_ma_gd m
           ON b.report_log_id = m.report_log_id
          AND b.section_id    = m.section_id
          AND b.row_order     = m.row_order
)
select * from pvt_dt;

column19:
WITH
-- 1. Thông tin chứng khoán: lấy bản ghi mới nhất mỗi (symbol, tradingdate)
stockinfor AS
(
        SELECT symbol, symbolisin, tradingdate, stocktype, floorcode, ds_etl_pcs_tms
        FROM (
                SELECT
                        js.symbol
                        , js.symbolisin
                        , js.tradingdate
                        , js.stocktype
                        , js.floorcode
                        , js.ds_etl_pcs_tms
                        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                PARTITION BY js.symbol, js.tradingdate
                                ORDER BY js.tradingtime DESC, sequence DESC
                        ) AS rn
                FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor js
                WHERE 1=1
                        AND js.tradingdate BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
                        AND js.stocktype IN (1,2,3,4,6)
        ) t
        WHERE t.rn = 1
)
-- 2. Base HOSE: quét trade_book 1 lần, gắn stocktype/floorcode, tách sẵn giá trị mua/bán NĐTNN
, hose_tb AS
(
        SELECT
                js.stocktype
                , js.floorcode
                , tb.market_id
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.buy_acct_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Execution_Value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.sell_acct_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Execution_Value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , tb.Execution_Value AS gtri
        FROM uat_hose_stg.trade_book tb
        JOIN stockinfor js
                ON tb.symbol = js.symbol AND tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate
        WHERE tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
                AND tb.market_id IN ('STK', 'BDO')
)
-- 3. Base HNX
, hnx_tb AS
(
        SELECT
                js.stocktype
                , js.floorcode
                , tb.market_id
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.buy_account_number ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.sell_account_number,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity AS gtri
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book tb
        JOIN stockinfor js
                ON js.symbolisin = tb.issue_code
                AND to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') = js.tradingdate
        WHERE tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdatee1 AND :pdatee2
                AND tb.market_id IN ('UPX', 'STX', 'HCX')
)
-- 4. Cổ phiếu: stocktype = 2 ; HOSE market_id = 'STK' ; HNX market_id IN ('UPX','STX')
, cte_cophieu AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM (
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hose_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 2 AND market_id = 'STK'
                UNION ALL
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hnx_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 2 AND market_id IN ('UPX', 'STX')
        ) x
)
-- 5. Trái phiếu DN niêm yết: stocktype = 1 ; HOSE market_id = 'BDO' ; HNX market_id = 'HCX'
, cte_tpdn_niemyet AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM (
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hose_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 1 AND market_id = 'BDO'
                UNION ALL
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hnx_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 1 AND market_id = 'HCX'
        ) x
)
-- 6. CCQ: stocktype IN (3,6)
--    (chưa có rule market_id nên giữ như câu lệnh gốc: HOSE = 'STK', HNX = 'UPX'/'STX')
, cte_ccq AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM (
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hose_tb
                WHERE stocktype IN (3,6) 
                UNION ALL
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hnx_tb
                WHERE stocktype IN (3,6) 
        ) x
)
-- 7. CW: stocktype = 4 AND floorcode = 10 (HOSE, market_id = 'STK')
, cte_cw AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM hose_tb
        WHERE stocktype = 4 AND floorcode = 10 AND market_id = 'STK'
)
-- 8. TP DN riêng lẻ: báo cáo HNX09
, cte_tpdn_riengle AS
(
        SELECT
                SUM(CASE WHEN fr.row_path = 'GIÁ TRỊ GIAO DỊCH NHÀ ĐẦU TƯ NƯỚC NGOÀI - GIÁ TRỊ MUA' THEN fr.field_value END) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua
                , SUM(CASE WHEN fr.row_path = 'GIÁ TRỊ GIAO DỊCH NHÀ ĐẦU TƯ NƯỚC NGOÀI - GIÁ TRỊ BÁN' THEN fr.field_value END) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban
                , SUM(CASE WHEN fr.row_path = 'GIÁ TRỊ GIAO DỊCH' THEN fr.field_value END) AS tong_gtri
        FROM uat_iss_ods.flat_report fr
        WHERE fr.report_code = 'HNX09'
                AND fr.submit_status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'LATE_SUBMITTED')
                -- TODO: bổ sung điều kiện kỳ báo cáo, ví dụ:
                -- AND fr.<cột_ngày_báo_cáo> BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
)
-- 9. TP chính phủ: Outright + Repo + Repo2
, tpcp_raw AS
(
        SELECT
                CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(a.buying_account_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN a.trading_value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(a.selling_account_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN a.trading_value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , a.trading_value AS gtri
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.OUTRIGHT_ORDER_BOOK a
        WHERE a.trading_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
                CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.buying_account_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.selling_account_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END
                , r.first_settlement_value
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.REPO_ORDER_BOOK r
        WHERE r.trading_date  BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
                CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.buying_account_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.selling_account_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END
                , r.first_settlement_value
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.REPO2_ORDER_BOOK r
        WHERE r.trading_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
)
, cte_tpcp AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM tpcp_raw
)
, cte_all AS
(
        SELECT 'CP' AS loai_ck, gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban, gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM cte_cophieu
                UNION ALL
        SELECT 'CCQ', gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban, gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM cte_ccq
                UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Chứng quyền', gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban, gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM cte_cw
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'TPCP', SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_ban), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban) as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM tpcp_raw
                UNION ALL
        SELECT 'TPDN RL', SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_ban), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban) as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM cte_tpdn_riengle
                UNION ALL
        SELECT 'TPDN NY', SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_ban), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua - gtri_ndtnn_ban) as gtri_mua_ban_rong FROM cte_tpdn_niemyet
)
select * from cte_all;

WITH
-- 1. Thông tin chứng khoán: lấy bản ghi mới nhất mỗi (symbol, tradingdate)
stockinfor AS
(
        SELECT symbol, symbolisin, tradingdate, stocktype, floorcode, ds_etl_pcs_tms
        FROM (
                SELECT
                        js.symbol
                        , js.symbolisin
                        , js.tradingdate
                        , js.stocktype
                        , js.floorcode
                        , js.ds_etl_pcs_tms
                        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                PARTITION BY js.symbol, js.tradingdate
                                ORDER BY js.tradingtime DESC, sequence DESC
                        ) AS rn
                FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor js
                WHERE 1=1
                        AND js.tradingdate BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
                        AND js.stocktype IN (1,2,3,4,6)
        ) t
        WHERE t.rn = 1
)
-- 2. Base HOSE: quét trade_book 1 lần, gắn stocktype/floorcode, tách sẵn giá trị mua/bán NĐTNN
, hose_tb AS
(
        SELECT
                js.stocktype
                , js.floorcode
                , tb.market_id
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.buy_acct_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Execution_Value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.sell_acct_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Execution_Value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , tb.Execution_Value AS gtri
        FROM uat_hose_stg.trade_book tb
        JOIN stockinfor js
                ON tb.symbol = js.symbol AND tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate
        WHERE tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
                AND tb.market_id IN ('STK', 'BDO')
)
-- 3. Base HNX
, hnx_tb AS
(
        SELECT
                js.stocktype
                , js.floorcode
                , tb.market_id
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.buy_account_number ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(tb.sell_account_number,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , tb.Trade_price * tb.Trade_quantity AS gtri
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book tb
        JOIN stockinfor js
                ON js.symbolisin = tb.issue_code
                AND to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') = js.tradingdate
        WHERE tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdatee1 AND :pdatee2
                AND tb.market_id IN ('UPX', 'STX', 'HCX')
)
-- 4. Cổ phiếu: stocktype = 2 ; HOSE market_id = 'STK' ; HNX market_id IN ('UPX','STX')
, cte_cophieu AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM (
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hose_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 2 AND market_id = 'STK'
                UNION ALL
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hnx_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 2 AND market_id IN ('UPX', 'STX')
        ) x
)
-- 5. Trái phiếu DN niêm yết: stocktype = 1 ; HOSE market_id = 'BDO' ; HNX market_id = 'HCX'
, cte_tpdn_niemyet AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM (
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hose_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 1 AND market_id = 'BDO'
                UNION ALL
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hnx_tb
                WHERE stocktype = 1 AND market_id = 'HCX'
        ) x
)
-- 6. CCQ: stocktype IN (3,6)
--    (chưa có rule market_id nên giữ như câu lệnh gốc: HOSE = 'STK', HNX = 'UPX'/'STX')
, cte_ccq AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM (
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hose_tb
                WHERE stocktype IN (3,6) 
                UNION ALL
                SELECT gtri_mua, gtri_ban, gtri FROM hnx_tb
                WHERE stocktype IN (3,6) 
        ) x
)
-- 7. CW: stocktype = 4 AND floorcode = 10 (HOSE, market_id = 'STK')
, cte_cw AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM hose_tb
        WHERE stocktype = 4 AND floorcode = 10 AND market_id = 'STK'
)
-- 8. TP DN riêng lẻ: báo cáo HNX09
, cte_tpdn_riengle AS
(
        SELECT
                SUM(CASE WHEN fr.row_path = 'GIÁ TRỊ GIAO DỊCH NHÀ ĐẦU TƯ NƯỚC NGOÀI - GIÁ TRỊ MUA' THEN fr.field_value END) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua
                , SUM(CASE WHEN fr.row_path = 'GIÁ TRỊ GIAO DỊCH NHÀ ĐẦU TƯ NƯỚC NGOÀI - GIÁ TRỊ BÁN' THEN fr.field_value END) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban
                , SUM(CASE WHEN fr.row_path = 'GIÁ TRỊ GIAO DỊCH' THEN fr.field_value END) AS tong_gtri
        FROM uat_iss_ods.flat_report fr
        WHERE fr.report_code = 'HNX09'
                AND fr.submit_status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'LATE_SUBMITTED')
                -- TODO: bổ sung điều kiện kỳ báo cáo, ví dụ:
                -- AND fr.<cột_ngày_báo_cáo> BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
)
-- 9. TP chính phủ: Outright + Repo + Repo2
, tpcp_raw AS
(
        SELECT
                CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(a.buying_account_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN a.trading_value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_mua
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(a.selling_account_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN a.trading_value ELSE 0 END AS gtri_ban
                , a.trading_value AS gtri
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.OUTRIGHT_ORDER_BOOK a
        WHERE a.trading_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
                CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.buying_account_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.selling_account_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END
                , r.first_settlement_value
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.REPO_ORDER_BOOK r
        WHERE r.trading_date  BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
                CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.buying_account_no ,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END
                , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(r.selling_account_no,4,1) IN ('E','F') THEN r.first_settlement_value ELSE 0 END
                , r.first_settlement_value
        FROM uat_hnx_stg.REPO2_ORDER_BOOK r
        WHERE r.trading_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
)
, cte_tpcp AS
(
        SELECT SUM(gtri_mua) AS gtri_ndtnn_mua, SUM(gtri_ban) AS gtri_ndtnn_ban, SUM(gtri) AS tong_gtri
        FROM tpcp_raw
)
-- 10. Trái phiếu = TP DN niêm yết + TP DN riêng lẻ + TP chính phủ
, cte_trai_phieu AS
(
        SELECT gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban FROM cte_tpdn_niemyet
        UNION ALL
        SELECT gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban FROM cte_tpdn_riengle
        UNION ALL
        SELECT gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban FROM cte_tpcp
)
-- 11. Hợp nhất 4 loại chứng khoán
, cte_all AS
(
        SELECT 1 AS stt, 'Cổ phiếu' AS loai_ck, gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban FROM cte_cophieu
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 2, 'Trái phiếu', SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua), SUM(gtri_ndtnn_ban) FROM cte_trai_phieu
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 3, 'Chứng quyền', gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban FROM cte_cw
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 4, 'CCQ', gtri_ndtnn_mua, gtri_ndtnn_ban FROM cte_ccq
)
SELECT
        , sumn(NVL(gtri_ndtnn_mua, 0))                          AS gtri_mua
        , sum(NVL(gtri_ndtnn_ban, 0))                          AS gtri_ban
        , sum(NVL(gtri_ndtnn_mua, 0) - NVL(gtri_ndtnn_ban, 0)) AS gtri_mua_ban_rong
FROM cte_all
ORDER BY stt;
